records.body_location: Final award and project milestones; three Arizona fabs by the end of the decade
records.evidence_summary: The final CHIPS award supports three Arizona fabs and disburses funding against project milestones.
records.transmission_path: Milestone-based public funding supports multi-year advanced-node fabrication investment.
records.invalidation_condition: Award termination, material cancellation of the Arizona buildout, or withdrawal of the stated milestone plan.

records.body_location: January 2026 Short-Term Energy Outlook press release
records.evidence_summary: EIA forecasts U.S. electricity use growth through 2027, driven largely by large computing facilities.
records.transmission_path: Sustained load growth increases the need for generation interconnection, transmission and distribution capacity.
records.invalidation_condition: A later EIA outlook removes the projected multi-year electricity-demand growth.

records.source_owner: U.S. Department of Energy Office of Electricity
records.body_location: Program overview, funding mechanisms and FY26 third funding round
records.evidence_summary: DOE administers the $10.5 billion GRIP program for grid flexibility, capacity, resilience and modernization.
records.transmission_path: Federal cost sharing directly supports transmission, distribution and smart-grid deployment.
records.invalidation_condition: Program rescission, cancellation of remaining funding rounds, or removal of grid deployment eligibility.

records.body_location: SPARK application schedule and anticipated August 2026 selections
records.evidence_summary: DOE announced a nearly $2 billion SPARK opportunity and an anticipated August 2026 selection milestone.
records.transmission_path: Selections can convert policy support into funded reconductoring and transmission-technology projects.
records.invalidation_condition: Selection timetable is withdrawn, funding is rescinded, or no projects are selected.

records.source_owner: U.S. Department of Energy Office of Nuclear Energy
records.body_location: U.S. target for 200 GW of new nuclear capacity by 2050
records.evidence_summary: DOE published a target for 200 GW of additional U.S. nuclear capacity by 2050.
records.transmission_path: A long-duration federal buildout target supports reactor, fuel-cycle and nuclear-services demand.
records.invalidation_condition: DOE formally withdraws or replaces the capacity target with a materially lower path.

records.body_location: 20-year Microsoft PPA, 2028 expected online date and licensing conditions
records.evidence_summary: Constellation signed a 20-year PPA supporting restart of the 835 MW Crane facility, with an expected 2028 online date.
records.transmission_path: A long-term offtake commitment supports nuclear generation capacity and supply-chain activity.
records.invalidation_condition: The borrower cancels the restart or the NRC denies required licensing approvals.

records.body_location: $17.5 billion conditional commitment and 2030 construction objective
records.evidence_summary: DOE issued a conditional commitment intended to accelerate long-lead procurement for up to ten large reactors.
records.transmission_path: Long-lead procurement can create a multi-year demand window for reactor components and nuclear manufacturing.
records.invalidation_condition: Conditions are not satisfied, partner projects fail to close, or the loan commitment is withdrawn.

records.source_owner: U.S. Congress and Library of Congress
records.body_location: P.L. 119-21 Title II funding summary and period of availability
records.evidence_summary: The enacted law provides $156.2 billion of defense funding with funds generally available through September 2029.
records.transmission_path: Multi-year appropriations support missiles, aircraft, shipbuilding and the defense industrial base.
records.invalidation_condition: Material rescission or reprogramming removes the relevant industrial-base funding.

records.body_location: The Hague defence commitment and 2035 target
records.evidence_summary: NATO allies committed to invest 5% of GDP annually in defence and security-related spending by 2035.
records.transmission_path: A multi-country spending path supports sustained equipment, munitions and readiness demand.
records.invalidation_condition: The commitment is formally revised downward or annual plans show broad non-implementation.

records.body_location: Presidential signing statement for the FY2026 NDAA
records.evidence_summary: The FY2026 NDAA was signed into law and authorizes national-security programs for the fiscal year.
records.transmission_path: Signed authorization sustains the near-term defense program and procurement calendar.
records.invalidation_condition: Appropriations do not fund material authorized programs or relevant authorities are repealed.

records.body_location: Treaty and code amendments in force from 1 January 2026
records.evidence_summary: Mandatory 2026 amendments add safety, monitoring and equipment requirements for covered ships.
records.transmission_path: Mandatory design and equipment standards support retrofit and compliant newbuild requirements.
records.invalidation_condition: Applicable amendments are repealed or implementation is broadly deferred.

records.evidence_summary: The order establishes a policy to rebuild domestic maritime industries and directs a Maritime Action Plan.
records.transmission_path: Federal procurement, financing and industrial-base actions can support shipyard capacity and vessel demand.
records.invalidation_condition: The order is revoked or the action plan removes shipbuilding support measures.

records.evidence_summary: The published action plan calls for long-term funding, procurement reform and demand for U.S.-built ships.
records.transmission_path: Implementation milestones can extend policy support into a multi-year shipbuilding investment cycle.
records.invalidation_condition: Implementation funding is not authorized or the plan is formally withdrawn.
